items.stem: 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

lines: G: What are you reading, Liam?
B: I’m reading an article about teens’ selfie habits.
G: That’s interesting. How often do teens take selfies?
B: It says many teens take selfies every day.
G: Wow! I often see my friends posting their selfies on social media.
B: The article also says it’s important to be careful about sharing selfies online.
G: Why is that important?
B: Because selfies can have personal information in them.
G: Right. Anyone can see that information.
B: Yeah. We should think twice before posting selfies.
B: boy, G: girl

choices: Liam often sees his friends posting their selfies on social media.
Selfies never have personal information in them.
The girl often sees her friends posting their selfies on social media.
The article says it’s not important to be careful about sharing selfies online.
We should think twice after posting selfies.
items.explain: I often see my friends posting their selfies on social media. ① 소녀가 본다 ② can have ④ it’s important ⑤ before posting. 대화 문장에서 한 단어씩 바꿈.

items.stem: 어법이 맞는 문장은?
choices: It is important eat breakfast every day.
The more you practice, the good you will do.
It was difficult to solve the math problem.
The harder you study, the high your score will be.
This is not easy to get up early.
items.explain: ① important to eat ② the better ④ the higher ⑤ 가주어는 It. 학습지 L5 grammar 1·2 문장을 변형.
items.source: 선생님 제작 어법 문장 (학습지 p.35~37 가주어 it · the 비교급)

items.stem: 대화의 흐름상 밑줄 (A)에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은?

lines: Lucy: Jake, are you throwing out that backpack?
Jake: Yeah. I don’t really use it anymore.
Lucy: But it looks new. These days, people throw out so many good items.
Jake: Right. Someone can still use my backpack. (A)______________________
Lucy: You can sell it through an online flea market.
Jake: That sounds good. I’ll give it a try.
Lucy: Great. Don’t forget to post pictures of the backpack.
Jake: Thanks for the tip.
Lucy: No problem!

choices: What can I do to find a new owner for it?
How often do you use it?
What can I do to start upcycling?
Don’t forget to post pictures of it.
How about having a picnic tomorrow?
items.explain: 방법을 묻는 What can I do to ~? 에 You can ~ 으로 답한다. 오답은 범위 대화문의 다른 문장.

items.stem: 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
items.box:
ⓐ I heard my friend talk on the phone.
ⓑ The man saw her to climb the hill.
ⓒ Let me to read this paper airplane.
ⓓ Trees will help clean the air.
ⓔ We watched him fixing the car.
ⓕ Greenhouse gases make the Earth hotter.
ⓖ Sumi and I heard the rain to fall on the tent.
items.explain: 지각동사(hear/see/watch)+목적어+동사원형/현재분사: ⓑ climb(climbing) ⓖ fall(falling). 사역동사 let+동사원형: ⓒ Let me read. ⓓ 준사역 help+동사원형(Trees will help clean the air.) ⓕ make+목적어+형용사(5형식). 원문: 학습지 p.44 E-1·2·3·8, L6 T2-B, L5 T1-A3, L5 본문.
items.source: 학습지 p.44 grammar 3-E 지각동사 + 범위 대화문·본문의 let/help/make 문장 (이전 시험 사역·5형식 연계)

lines: Dear Monica,

I am Homin from Korea. (A) I read your story about Venice. (B) From now on, I’m going to walk or ride a bike to nearby places. (C) I’m also going to eat less meat because cows increase greenhouse gases. (D) These are little things, but I’ll do my part for Venice! (E) I wish you good luck.
Best wishes,
Homin

items.stem: 윗글의 목적으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
choices: Monica에게 지구 온난화를 늦추기 위해 자신이 할 일을 알리려고
소가 가스를 많이 배출하는 이유를 설명하려고
items.explain: 지구 온난화를 늦추기 위해 자신이 할 일을 Monica 에게 알리는 편지.

items.stem: (A)~(E) 중 <보기>의 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

box.title: <보기>
lines: I want to do something to slow down global warming.

items.explain: 이야기를 읽었다 → 무언가를 하고 싶다 → From now on 구체적 행동.

items.stem: 대화의 밑줄 (A)~(E) 중 윗글과 내용이 일치하지 <u>않는</u> 것은?

lines: Monica: Hi, Homin.
Homin: Hi, Monica. (A)<u>I read your story about Venice.</u>
Monica: Really? What will you do?
Homin: (B)<u>From now on, I’m going to walk or ride a bike to nearby places.</u>
Monica: Anything else?
Homin: (C)<u>I’m also going to eat more meat because cows increase greenhouse gases.</u>
Monica: That’s amazing!
Homin: (D)<u>These are little things, but I’ll do my part for Venice!</u> (E)<u>I wish you good luck.</u>
Monica: Thanks, Homin!

items.explain: eat less meat because cows increase greenhouse gases. (대화의 밑줄은 본문 문장 그대로, (C)만 한 단어 바꿈 — 기출 7번 유형)
items.source: L5 My Writing (교과서 기타 지문) · 밑줄 문장은 본문 그대로

items.stem: 대화를 읽고 답할 수 <u>없는</u> 질문은?

lines: Jake: Ms. Hong, may I come in?
Ms. Hong: Sure, Jake. What’s wrong?
Jake: I feel stressed about the exams next week.
Ms. Hong: Oh, no. How often do you feel this way?
Jake: Almost every time I think about exams.
Ms. Hong: I understand. It’s important to manage your stress during exams.
Jake: But I don’t know how. What should I do?
Ms. Hong: You can take a walk and get some fresh air. Also, you can do some stretching.
Jake: Those are great tips. I will try them.
Ms. Hong: Studying with your friends can also lower your stress.
Jake: Okay. Thank you for your advice!

choices: Jake는 스트레스를 관리하기 위해 무엇을 할 수 있는가?
Jake는 몇 명의 친구와 함께 공부하는가?
items.explain: ① 다음 주 시험 ② 시험 생각할 때마다 ③ 산책·스트레칭·친구와 공부 ④ next week. ⑤ 언급 없음.

lines: Hello, I’m Suin from Korea. (A)<u>Every summer, it rain a lot here.</u> Sometimes, we have floods and they are really scary. (B)<u>The situation in Venice must be scary, too.</u> (C)<u>I’ve never been to Venice</u>, but (D)<u>I have saw many beautiful pictures of it.</u> I talked to my friends about the floods in your city. We wanted to help Venice, so we started the 3R campaign. The 3Rs are Recycle, Reuse, and Reduce. Now, (E)<u>many students at my school is doing these three things every day.</u> (G)<u>It is important to do our part for Venice.</u> (F)<u>Together, we can make a difference!</u>

items.stem: (A)~(E) 중 어법이 바르지 <u>않은</u> 것의 개수는?
items.explain: (A) it rains (수일치) (D) have seen (현재완료 — 1학기 문법 연계) (E) many students … are doing (수일치). (B)(C) 맞음. 일부러 바꿔 쓴 문장.
items.source: L5 본문 3대목 Suin (교과서 본문) — (A)(D)(E) 는 어법 문항용 변형

items.stem: 밑줄 (F)가 의미하는 바로 가장 알맞은 것은?
choices: 베네치아 사람들만이 그 문제를 해결할 수 있다.
많은 사람의 작은 실천이 변화를 만들 수 있다.
한국의 홍수가 베네치아의 홍수보다 더 무섭다.
items.explain: 함께(우리의 역할을 하면) 변화를 만들 수 있다. 기출 10번(속담)은 문화 지식 문항이라 밑줄 의미 추론으로 바꿈.

items.stem: 밑줄 (G)와 같은 의미가 되도록 to부정사구를 주어로 하는 문장을 쓰시오. (4점)
items.answer: To do our part for Venice is important.
items.explain: 가주어 It 을 없애고 진주어 to부정사구를 문장 앞에 둔다. (학습지 p.35 A-1)
items.source: L5 본문 3대목 Suin · 학습지 p.35 가주어 it

items.stem: 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 순서대로 바르게 배열한 것은?

lines: B: I don’t spend enough time with my family these days.
B: Okay, I’ll try.
B: boy, G: girl
(A) It’s important to eat with your family more often.
(B) Hmm. How often do you have dinner with your family, Minho?
(C) I have dinner with my family twice a week.

items.explain: 빈도 묻기 → 답 → 충고(It’s important to ~).

items.stem: (A)~(E) 중 It의 쓰임이 나머지와 <u>다른</u> 하나는?

lines: (A) <u>It</u> is important to exercise regularly.
(B) <u>It</u> is a beautiful city on the water in Italy.
(C) <u>It</u> isn’t easy to change my eating habits, but I’m doing my best.
(D) <u>It</u> was not easy to solve the puzzle.
(E) <u>It</u> is important to do our part for Venice.

items.explain: (B) 는 Venice 를 가리키는 대명사, 나머지는 가주어 It(진주어 to부정사). 기출 12번(용법 다른 하나)의 자리. 문장은 학습지 p.35·36 · 본문 그대로.
items.source: 학습지 p.35~36 가주어 it · L5 본문 (교과서 본문)

items.stem: 밑줄 친 단어의 쓰임이 의미상 <u>어색한</u> 문장은?
choices: She is the <u>captain</u> of the hockey team at school.
Listening to music can <u>lower</u> your stress.
The <u>principal</u> of our school welcomed the new students.
The fans <u>trusted</u> when their team won the game.
items.explain: The fans screamed when their team won the game. 나머지는 학습지 예문 그대로.

box.title: Save the City on the Water
lines: Hello, friends! My name is Monica, and I live in Venice. Have you (A)( hear / heard ) of Venice? It is a beautiful city on the water in Italy. Venice is famous for its canals and historic buildings. Many tourists come to see them every year. But now, we have a big problem. Last week, the streets (B)( flooded / were flooded ). I couldn’t go to school, and my parents’ bakery had to close. I had to wear tall rain boots all the time. I’m really worried. The warmer the Earth gets, the (C)( higher / highest ) the water in Venice rises. (D)______________________. My city needs your help!

items.stem: Monica가 지난주에 학교에 갈 수 없었던 이유는?
items.explain: Last week, the streets were flooded. I couldn’t go to school.

items.stem: (A)~(C)에 알맞은 것은?
items.explain: (A) Have you heard 현재완료 (B) 수동태 were flooded (1학기 문법) (C) the 비교급 ~, the 비교급 …
items.source: L5 본문 1대목 Monica · 학습지 p.35 the 비교급

items.stem: 밑줄 (D)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: Many tourists come to see them every year
We will do better from now on
Greenhouse gases make the Earth hotter
items.explain: 수위가 올라가면 → 곧 물에 잠길 수 있다 → 도움이 필요하다. 오답은 범위 본문·대화문의 다른 문장.

items.stem: <보기>의 문장 중 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것의 개수는?

box.title: <보기>
lines: - Venice is famous for its canals and historic buildings.
- Few tourists come to see them every year.
- Last week, the streets were not flooded.
- Monica couldn’t go to school, and her parents’ bakery had to close.
- Monica didn’t have to wear tall rain boots all the time.
- The warmer the Earth gets, the higher the water in Venice rises.
- Venice could be underwater soon.

items.explain: 일치 4개. 불일치: Few tourists(Many), were not flooded(were flooded), didn’t have to wear(had to wear). 본문 문장에서 한 단어씩 바꿈.

items.stem: <보기>의 어떤 빈칸에도 들어갈 수 <u>없는</u> 단어는?

box.title: <보기>
lines: - Listening to music can ________ your stress.
- The band will ________ at the school festival.
- Somebody ________ the news yesterday.
- I will ________ money to buy a new bike.

items.explain: lower / perform / spread / save. 학습지 예문 그대로.

box.title: Club News: Spreading Cheer Everywhere
lines: Let’s meet Fly High, our school’s cheerleading club. The club started from an idea of one student two years ago. Now, there are 10 girls and 6 boys in the club. (F)<u>Each member have a special energy.</u> Do you remember the recent school basketball game? After two quarters, our team was losing by 20 points. During halftime, Fly High came on the court. (A)<u>They</u> performed wonderfully. They flipped in the air and made a human pyramid. Then (B)<u>they</u> shouted, “Never give up!” And guess what? Our team won the game in the end. Jina, the captain of the club, said, “I can flip in the air because (C)<u>I</u> trust my club members. (G)<u>When I see the crowd to cheer and to scream, I feel proud.</u> Fly High is the best part of (D)<u>my</u> middle school life!” (H)<u>여러분은 다음 주 학교 축제에서 Fly High가 공연하는 것을 볼 수 있습니다.</u> Come and feel (E)<u>their</u> energy!

items.stem: <보기> 중 밑줄 (A)~(E)와 지시하는 대상이 바르게 연결된 것을 모두 고른 것은?

box.title: <보기>
lines: ⓐ (A) They – Fly High
ⓑ (B) they – our team
ⓒ (C) I – Jina
ⓓ (D) my – Jina
ⓔ (E) their – the crowd

items.explain: (B) they = Fly High, (E) their = Fly High(’s). 나머지 맞음.

items.stem: <보기>의 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어 중 윗글에 있지 <u>않은</u> 것은?

box.title: <보기>
lines: ⓐ one of four equal parts of a game, like in basketball or American football
ⓑ to turn (something) over by throwing it up in the air with a quick movement
ⓒ an athlete who is chosen to be the leader of a team
ⓓ a large group of people who are together in one place
ⓔ the person in charge of a public school

items.explain: ⓐ quarter ⓑ flip ⓒ captain ⓓ crowd 는 본문에 있음. ⓔ principal 은 없음.

items.stem: 밑줄 (F)와 (G)를 어법에 맞게 고쳐 문장 전체를 다시 쓰시오. (6점, 각 3점)
items.answer: (1) Each member has a special energy. (2) When I see the crowd cheering and screaming, I feel proud. (cheer and scream 도 인정)
items.explain: (F) each + 단수 명사 + 단수 동사. (G) 지각동사 see + 목적어 + 동사원형/현재분사. 본문 문장을 일부러 틀리게 바꿔 실었다.
items.source: L6 본문 1대목 Fly High · 학습지 p.42 each 수일치 · 지각동사

items.stem: <보기>에서 필요한 단어만 골라 (H)의 해석에 맞게 영어 문장을 완성하시오. (단, 필요한 경우 형태를 바꿀 수 있음.) (4점)

box.title: <보기>
lines: you, can, watch, Fly High, do, their, performance, at, the school festival, next week, to, their

items.answer: You can watch Fly High doing their performance at the school festival next week. (do 도 인정)
items.explain: 지각동사 watch + 목적어 + 현재분사/동사원형.

items.stem: <보기>의 우리말과 일치하도록 괄호 안의 단어를 활용하여 지각동사를 포함한 문장을 완성하시오. (6점, 각 3점)

box.title: <보기>
lines: (1) 그 부모는 그들의 아기가 방에서 우는 것을 들었다. (hear, cry)
→ The parents ______________________ in the room.
(2) 마을 사람들은 그 땅이 흔들리는 것을 느꼈다. (feel, shake)

items.answer: (1) heard the baby cry (crying) (2) felt the ground shake (shaking)
items.explain: 지각동사 + 목적어 + 동사원형/현재분사. 학습지 문장 그대로.
items.source: 학습지 p.44 L6 grammar 3-E 지각동사 6·5번 문장 그대로

items.stem: 조건에 맞게 문장을 완성하시오. (4점)

lines: <보기> important, get, is, it, to, eight, hours, of, sleep
B: I feel tired these days.
G: How often do you get enough sleep, Sejun?
B: Once a week. I usually stay up late watching videos.
B: boy, G: girl

condition: 조건 1. <보기>에 주어진 단어를 모두 사용할 것.
items.answer: It is important to get eight hours of sleep every night.
items.explain: 가주어 It + is + 형용사 + to부정사(진주어).
items.source: L6 Listen & Speak 1-A3 (교과서 대화문 그대로) · 학습지 p.35 가주어 it

items.stem: 소녀가 소년에게 대기 오염을 줄이기 위한 방법을 묻는 대화문이 되도록 밑줄 (A)에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오. (4점)

lines: G: Look at the sky! It’s gray.
B: Yeah. Air pollution is a big problem.
B: Start with little things. For example, walk to nearby places.
G: Oh, that’s easy. Anything else?
B: Don’t forget to care for your plants.
B: boy, G: girl

items.answer: What can we do to reduce air pollution
items.explain: 방법 묻기: What can we do to + 동사원형 ~?

items.stem: 대화를 읽고 조건에 맞게 답하시오. (12점, 각 3점)

lines: B: My dog doesn’t have energy lately.
G: (A)<u>너는 얼마나 자주 너의 개를 산책시키니?</u>
B: I walk him twice a week.
G: (B)<u>너의 개를 매일 산책시키는 것이 중요해.</u> (C)<u>그런 식으로, 그는 건강을 유지할 수 있어.</u>
B: Okay, I’ll start walking him every day.
G: Great. 너도 같이 걸으면 좋아. (D)<u>네가 더 많이 운동할수록, 너의 몸은 더 튼튼해질 거야.</u>
B: boy, G: girl

condition: 조건 1. 밑줄 (A)~(C)는 괄호 안의 말을 이용하여 영작할 것.
조건 2. 밑줄 (D)는 「the 비교급 ~, the 비교급 …」과 괄호 안의 말(exercise, strong, become)을 사용하여 영작할 것.
items.answer: (A) How often do you walk your dog? (B) It’s important to walk your dog every day. (C) That way, he can stay healthy. (D) The more you exercise, the stronger your body will become.
items.explain: (A) 빈도 묻기 (B) 가주어 it (C) 대화문 그대로 (D) the 비교급 ~, the 비교급 … (학습지 p.37 B-(2) 그대로).
items.source: L6 Check Up A (교과서 대화문 그대로) · 학습지 p.37 grammar 3-B the 비교급
